# Mesh winner v1 vectors

Authority: NS `docs/plan/PLAN-218-mesh-contract.md` C2 (86d857d8).
Independent definite-length/shortest-integer Python CBOR encoder and OpenSSL Ed25519
produce the frozen request, found, and unavailable payload/envelope/UDP/WSS bytes.
Synthetic signing seed is 0x0d repeated 32 times, timestamp 1000, nonce 0x05 repeated
16 times. Field values are explicit in the accompanying contract test; found uses
u64::MAX sequence. These vectors prove wire compatibility, not carrier authorization
or PIN end-to-end behavior. No production secrets or runtime evidence are included.
